candidate.answerReason: Since sin x ≤ 1, 2 sin x ≤ 2, with equality at x = π/2.

methods.label: Read the amplitude
methods.explanation: \(A=2>0\), so the maximum value is the amplitude, \(2\).
methods.levelReason: The centered sinusoid has nonzero frequency, so its amplitude directly gives its maximum.

methods.label: Bound the sine and attain the bound
methods.explanation: The sine function never exceeds \(1\), so \(2\sin x\le2\) for every real \(x\). At \(x=\pi/2\), \(\sin x=1\), so this bound is attained. Therefore the maximum value is \(2\).
methods.levelReason: This uses the basic sine maximum, a special-angle value, and multiplication of an inequality by a positive number, requiring no amplitude formula.
